data.body:
CI feedback fix (Gerrit 2449 patch set 3 → Verified −1, run 33343573117) — root-caused and fixed; NOT flaky, no recheck.

Three of the change's OWN guard/fixture tests correctly rejected patch set 3. Phase-1 root cause for each:

1. `test_repo_root_from_tracker_guard.py::test_no_config_root_site_is_deferred_behind_a_sanction` and `::test_exactly_one_shared_store_root_seam_exists` — MARKER-TOKEN NAMESPACE COLLISION. The pre-existing tracker guard's self-tests literally substring-scan all of `src/` for the tokens `# repo-root-ok` and `# repo-root-seam` and enforce a global allowlist (only `_store/sync.py` may carry `# repo-root-ok`; only `_proc.py` may carry `# repo-root-seam`, the single store-root seam). My new package guard REUSED those exact tokens for its own sanctions on `config.py` (seam) and `__main__.py` (ok), so the tracker guard's scans saw them as new store-root deferrals/seams.
   - This is NOT a design conflict and needs NO allowlist change: `_proc.py`'s seam resolves the STORE's git-repo root via `dirname(<tracker>)`; `reconciler_repo_root()` resolves the CODE checkout (REBAR_ROOT / validated package root / validated cwd toplevel) and must stay CWD-independent — routing it through the store-root seam would be semantically wrong. Option C is unchanged and stays as certified.
   - FIX: the package guard now uses its OWN distinct marker namespace, `# pkg-root-ok:` / `# pkg-root-seam:` (verified absent elsewhere in the tree; not a substring of the tracker tokens). config.py and __main__.py updated to the new tokens; the guard script constants and the guard's self-test updated to match. The tracker guard's allowlist is untouched — its two self-tests pass because `# repo-root-*` no longer appears at my sites.

2. `test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py::test_make_lint_rejects_live_vocabulary_through_guard` — FIXTURE STAGING GAP. That test builds an isolated repo and runs `make lint`, stubbing every lint gate that runs AHEAD of the vocabulary guard by writing an empty `scripts/<name>.py`. I wired `check_repo_root_from_package.py` into the lint target between the tracker guard and the vocabulary guard, but the fixture didn't stub it, so `make lint` died with "No such file" before reaching the guard under test.
   - FIX: added the one-line stub `(scripts / "check_repo_root_from_package.py").write_text("", ...)` in that fixture, matching how the other ~10 ahead-of-guard scripts are handled (the operator-noted established pattern).

Local re-verification (worktree venv on PATH): the 3 tests pass; the package guard still passes clean on the drained tree (exit 0, 2 sanctioned sites) and flags a reintroduced raw instance; `make lint` green; `make typecheck` green (719 files); reconciler/guard/vocabulary suites green (195 passed, 3 skipped in the reconcile/fetch selection; 113 in the guard/seam selection).

Pushed as patch set 4 to Gerrit 2449. No `--force`, no guard-allowlist edit, no gate bypass. Ticket stays in_progress pending Verified +1 + LLM-Review +1 on the new patch set.
